integrity: The equilibrium formulas, characteristic polynomial, Routh count, and baseline algebra were independently reconstructed from the printed vector field; numerical eigenvalues are consistency checks rather than proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the exact nonzero equilibrium branch and identifies the classical differentiability failure at the central equilibrium. It does not classify global attractors or assert a nonsmooth stability type at the central equilibrium.
title: Exact nonzero-equilibrium index and a nonsmooth-origin correction in a financial flow
